why: Hand-authored situational practice items for ALL twelve A1.1 Lektionen. The first DaF review of 2026-09-12 measured the legacy grammar bank as drill rather than situation (L10 drew 0 of 7 items containing a Wortfeld word, L12 2, L6 3, L5 4) and the second review measured what the first batch left open: L9 3/7, L3 3/7, L11 3/7, L2 4/7, L4 4/7, plus L8 drawing two unsolvable ordinal-number items and L1/L7 leaning on words the Lektion never uses. Every item here uses the exact Wortfeld of its Lektion (src/data/curricula/a11.js, read only) plus earlier Lektionen, is typed production (fill_blank without options, sentence_building or error_correction), is German-only in prompt and answer, and passes src/data/lessonPools/quality.js. THREE RULES the second review asked for, applied to every item: (1) the answer follows unambiguously from the GERMAN prompt — where several verbs fit a gap the prompt carries the infinitive cue „(fahren)“, and where several forms are correct they are all in `accepted` (extra-a11-l10-01 now accepts Fährt/Geht/Kommt, as its own Lektion pretest does); (2) `accepted` carries the lowercase variant only where the gap is sentence-initial — the höfliche „Ihr“ and the mid-sentence „ein/eine/sein“ are case-strict, because capitalisation is the taught distinction; (3) every task instruction uses Sie („Bilden Sie die Frage“, „Korrigieren Sie“, „Schreiben Sie“), matching the course, while the dialogues keep du between friends (review §C). Intonation questions are no longer marked wrong: the two error_correction items on „Der Zug fährt nach …?“ now ask for the WRITTEN question form. scripts/build-lesson-pool.mjs merges this file into a11.json under the same filter; tests/lesson-extra-items.test.mjs pins the Wortfeld hit and the resulting draw. ROUND 3 (REVIEW-daf-3-2026-09-12): the hand-authored batch was itself reviewed and corrected — L11 lost three NON-separable verbs (frühstücken/duschen/schlafen) from the Satzklammer Lektion and gained abholen/mitkommen/anrufen; three L3 items drilled possessive endings (L12) and the Vokalwechsel du-form sprichst (deferred to L7) under a personal-pronouns label and are now genuine pronoun items; two L2 number-spelling items tagged verb-sein are now sein items; L7 no longer demands Samstag (taught in L8) and L8 no longer Vormittag (taught nowhere); L10 asks for the normal word order instead of calling a marked question an error; every gap whose answer is a verb carries its infinitive in the GERMAN prompt, and no English gloss carries a bracket the German prompt lacks. The rule behind the round: a topic mark is a routing label, so tests/lesson-extra-items.test.mjs now measures what the ANSWER drills, per Lektion.

items.questionEn: Mrs Kaya, do you speak English? Formal address.

die Kollegin ist feminin: eine Kollegin.
das Telefon ist neutral: ein Telefon.

Der Termin ist am Dienstag um acht Uhr
